d: Despite leaving his love behind and starting fresh, the surprising presence of Yamac's mother disturbs all of his feelings asking him to return and aid the family legacy. Aras Bulut Iynemli, Erkan Kolcak Kostendil.

After Moataz was involved in fighting the French occupier, he had to escape and hide in some house. So he hid at Mousa's family and fell in love with his daughter, Sara. But her father refuses their marriage. Thereafter, Sara is kidnapped by another man. Abas Al Noury, Ayman Zidan.

Revived from death, Saber Al Maddah faces a fierce battle against dark forces bent on freeing the devil. As he fights, his personal life becomes ensnared in a web of hidden secrets that threaten his fate and humanity's survival. Hamada Helal, Ghada Adel.

Romance Sai Joshi dreams of joining the Nagpur Medical College and becoming a doctor one day, but her steps are hindered when her family forces her to marry an IPS officer who is in love with another woman, so they make a secret deal that comforts both of them. Ayesha Singh, Neil Bhatt.

Falsely accused of murdering his wife and daughters, Abbas Al Rayes is sentenced to fifteen years in prison. After his release, Abbas is consumed by a thirst for revenge and a desire for salvation. Amr Saad, Hatem Salah.
Saad is a lawyer who takes a lot of cases until he grows wealthy and famous; nonetheless, he starts exploiting people's needs for his service. Naif Al Rashed, Mariam Al Saleh.
